NAME: Angel
TEXT: Meet Our Black-and-White Beauty - Charlies Angel AKA Angel This fun-loving young greyhound is full of energy and charm! With her striking black-and-white coat and playful personality, she’s sure to steal hearts wherever she goes. She’s active and loves to run, play, and explore, making her the perfect companion for someone who enjoys an adventurous lifestyle. Despite her zest for life, she’s also sweet and affectionate, always ready for a cuddle after a day of fun. If you’re looking for a social, spirited, and loving friend to brighten your days, this gorgeous girl is ready to join your family!

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Pepper is a stunning 3-year-old brindle greyhound with a vibrant personality! She’s sweet, smart, and full of playful energy always ready for a game or a cuddle. Pepper is wonderfully social and loves spending time with people and other dogs, making her the perfect companion for an active and loving home. Her intelligence and affectionate nature mean she’ll quickly become your best friend and a cherished member of the family. If you’re looking for a fun, loving, and loyal companion, Pepper is ready to bring joy and excitement into your life!

NAME: Bindi
TEXT: Bindi is a beautiful 6-year-old fawn greyhound with a heart full of love and a gentle nature. She adores snuggles and will happily curl up beside you for some quality cuddle time. Bindi is fantastic with kids and gets along wonderfully with other dogs, making her an ideal addition to a family home. Her calm, affectionate personality and sweet demeanor will melt your heart every single day. If you’re looking for a loyal, loving companion who thrives on affection and brings peace and joy to your home, Bindi is the perfect match!

NAME: Sylvie
TEXT: Sylvie is a gorgeous 2.5 year old greyhound with a heart full of love and a playful streak that will brighten your day. She’s sweet, affectionate, and always ready for cuddles, her favorite thing is being close to her people. Sylvie loves to play and explore, making her a wonderful companion for an active family or anyone who enjoys fun and snuggles in equal measure. If you’re looking for a loyal friend who will shower you with affection and bring joy to your home, Sylvie is the perfect match!

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jasper! 💙 Jasper is an affectionate, sweet, and kind-hearted boy who just wants to be loved. 🐶 He’s playful and gentle, with so much potential to shine in the right home. He’s still learning and will need a supportive family to continue his training and help build his confidence. Jasper would do best with older, understanding children and could get along well with a compatible medium-large dog. If you're ready to open your heart to a truly lovable companion, Jasper is waiting for you! 💕

NAME: Dior
TEXT: Dior is a stunning young lady with a gentle soul and a playful spirit. She’s the perfect mix of elegance and affection, making her an ideal companion for any family. Dior is wonderfully social, she gets along beautifully with kids, cats, and other dogs, creating harmony wherever she goes. Her sweet nature indoors and love for snuggles make her a joy to have at home, while her curious and fun personality shines during walks and playtime, If you’re looking for a loving, adaptable, and well-mannered friend, Dior is ready to steal your heart!

NAME: Elsa (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Do you wanna build a snowman? or perhaps a bond to last a lifetime? MEET ELSA! At first, this sweet girl can be a little quiet, think “gentle snowfall,” not a blizzard but give her a moment and she’ll reveal a warm, affectionate personality that shines brighter than a frozen palace at sunrise. Elsa may have just three legs, but don’t worry, she gets around beautifully, and what she lacks in limbs she more than makes up for with love, charm, and an irresistible sparkle. She’s proof that being a little different just makes you more magical. ✨ Because she needs space to move comfortably and confidently, Elsa would be happiest as the one and only royal in her castle. A home without stairs is ideal too, so she can glide gracefully without having to conquer any mountains (even if she could, she shouldn’t have to!). If you’re ready to welcome a princess with courage, charm, and a heart as warm as summer, Elsa is ready to choose you. ❄️💙

NAME: Wilma
TEXT: Wilma is ready to find a place to call home! This sweet girl can be a little shy at first, but with a chance to warm up, she'll be your Bestie in no time! Wilma gets along not only with her Greyhound mates, but smaller dogs too. Pending a meet and greet, she wouldn't mind sharing her new home with one or two other canine companions. Wilma also responds well to her name and travels well! If you think Wilma could be the one for you, meet her at Western Sydney!

NAME: Bernie
TEXT: Bernie is a laid-back legend who loves car rides and walks! He’s great on the lead and enjoys taking life at a relaxed pace. While he might be a little shy at first, Bernie warms up quickly and will soon be your loyal mate. He’s easy-going, chilled, and gets along with all dogs—making him the perfect companion for a calm and happy home. “Bernie – Your easy-going adventure buddy!”

NAME: Jude
TEXT: Hey Jude! Jude is a sweet lad, who is suitable to live with small or big dogs. He is a confident boy who would do well in urban/city environments and would suit longer hours alone if required. He would prefer a home without stairs but could live in a unit with a lift access. This affectionate, calm boy would be a lovely match for a family with respetcful children, too. Meet Jude at Western Sydney.

NAME: Elsa
TEXT: Meet Elsa, a confident and upbeat canine companion who's ready to bring a touch of joy and warmth to your life. Elsa's cheerful and friendly nature makes her a delight to be around. Elsa has met small dogs and was polite and friendly. She serves as a wonderful role model, showing off her confident demeanor and spreading her joy, particularly to her sister Anna. When Anna is feeling unsure, Elsa is right there to give her the confidence she needs. Elsa comes alive during playtime, shedding any shyness as she relates to those around her. Her caring, lively personality make her a perfect match for a household with small dogs or a family looking for a devoted and joyful four-legged friend. With Elsa by your side, you can expect a life filled with adventure, companionship, and endless affection for all members of the family. Whether sharing a sunny afternoon on the lawn or snuggling together after a long day, Elsa is eager to be a part of your life. Will you be the lucky family to welcome this radiant, lovable dog into your home?

NAME: Anna
TEXT: Meet Anna, a sweet and gentle soul who's looking for a kind-hearted family to welcome her into their lives. Despite her quiet and shy demeanor, Anna has a heart full of love once she feels comfortable in her surroundings. She finds security and confidence when she’s with her sister, suggesting that another friendly canine companion might help her continue to come out of her shell. Anna is the kind of dog who will appreciate a calm and understanding household, where her quiet nature can truly shine. Her gentle disposition brings a serene energy into the home, and with time, her shy exterior will reveal a wonderfully sweet and affectionate personality. If you're seeking a loyal and devoted friend who is eager to bond and bloom in a loving environment, Anna could be the perfect addition to your family. With patience and companionship, Anna promises to be a loyal, loving, and rewarding presence in your life.

NAME: Crab
TEXT: Hey, my name is Crab! I am confident, affectionate, love all people and will definitely jump on the couch for a cuddle! I am suitable for a home with a courtyard or backyard. I am a gentle soul but wiggly and goofy when I'm playing so a home with older kids is best suited. I would love someone around at home more often than not, so that I can learn your routine and thrive in becoming the best pet I can be. I am social with other dogs including small dogs while on walks and outings however would prefer a home without a dog friend. I hope you want to meet me! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rueben
TEXT: Meet Rueben – a charming guy who strikes the perfect balance between laid-back and playful. Naturally calm and easygoing, Rueben is happy to relax and take life at a gentle pace. He loves a good play session and perks right up when it’s time for snacks or a game. He's been around Westies, Cavoodles and Italian Greyhounds. His best fit for a doggie pal would be a calm female. Rueben walks beautifully on the lead, making strolls a breeze, and he enjoys getting out and about with his people. With his sweet nature and joyful bursts of enthusiasm, Rueben would be a great fit for a home that enjoys both relaxed cuddles and lighthearted fun. Meet Rueben from Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Kayla
TEXT: *I'm in foster! Meet me by getting in touch with the team*! Hi, I'm Kayla! I currently live with a bunch of small dogs and greyhounds, love spending time on the couch roaching indoors in my foster care home, and enjoy zooming around with toys in the yard! Of course nobody can catch up to me which is a super fun game! I'd love a home where I can have a backyard for play time (and taking my toys outside to decorate the yard), and a home where I can have indoor outdoor access as I please. I would thrive in a multi dog home and am seeking a home with canine companionship. Meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre via appointment with my foster carer.

NAME: Quail
TEXT: Quail is in foster care and has been described as "nothing but a gentleman" and has made quite an impression on the locals in his neighbourhood! Children enjoy patting him and he has been a friend to all dogs big and small when on walks. He has visited friends houses, the beach, gone on car rides, fine with motorbikes, wheelchairs and urban living. Gentle by nature, Quail loves pats and affection from his human friends and enjoys getting out and about for a stroll, walking gently on lead along the way. He pairs well with other Greyhounds, so pending a meet and greet, may suit a home with another medium to large breed. Quail is happy lounging around or catching some rays in the morning sun. He's shown to settle well indoors and on his own so may suit an apartment or townhouse set up or a home with someone who works part time or full time, with a chance to work up to long hours alone. A calm, quiet environment to match his laid back energy would be great for this handsome guy! Meet Quail at Western Sydney!

NAME: Betsy
TEXT: Little Betsy is the life of the party! This small girl loves nothing more than playing with her toys and bringing a smile to everyone she meets. She’s always up for an adventure and enjoys going for a stroll where she can take her time and explore the environment to take in the world around her. Betsy is friendly and polite with medium to large dogs, but her favourite companions are people! She’s been making terrific progress in her training and is eager to keep learning. Betsy would thrive in a home with a backyard in a quieter area, where she's able to enjoy plenty of company throughout the day as she continues to learn how to relax on her own. Her excitable, goofy nature makes her best suited to a family with older children who can join in her fun, yet respect her space. She loves her toys and has a high food drive, making her training sessions an absolute ball. She has learnt "on your bed" and how to lay down and settle on her bed. If you’ve got space on your couch, Betsy just might be the perfect fit! Contact the team at the Western Sydney Adoption Centre to meet her.

NAME: Jellybean
TEXT: This sweetheart is happy to focus on herself and stay in her own lane. She has lived around cats for the last couple of years along with other dogs and a mixture of random animals that she sees around the property. She is great with kids and would suit a laid back style of life.

NAME: Breeze
TEXT: Breeze can be a cheeky funny girl who is great company, she loves playing with toys and is a social, playful character when she is in the large yard with the other hounds. She live around native and domestic animals.

NAME: Grace
TEXT: Grace is a lovely girl who has been living in a rural setting around domestic and native animals. Although she lives around wide open spaces this girl loves her bed and would rather lounge around through the day.

NAME: Sam
TEXT: Sam is a gorgeous gentle girl. She has cats living around her in her current home and was assessed with a kitten. She also see's native and domestic animals daily. Relaxed is an understatement to describe this pretty girl.

NAME: Pamela
TEXT: This beautiful girl has been around kids and a wide range of animals in her life. She is lovely and calm and just wants a comfy bed and some love. She is very relaxed and gentle.

NAME: Bucket
TEXT: This pretty girl is great sharing her space with other hounds, she is playful and fun, she likes toys. She lives in an area surrounded by native and farm animals.

NAME: Opal (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Opal has zest for life that can be paralleled by none! He is a very friendly and affectionate boy, and loves just loves everyone he meets! His outgoing personality has made him a fan favourite here at GAP HQ. Opal would love a backyard to call his own and would do best in a quieter area so he can live his best chilled out life. Respectful children are suitable, however Opal would prefer to be the only pet in the household so he can soak up all the love and attention for himself. Shorter hours are preferred while he settles in, a human presence during the day will help him feel his best - from home workers or retirees would be his perfect match! So come on down down and excavate this precious and valuable Opal today! Submit an application to take him home. He is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bonnie
TEXT: ~ Meet Bonnie! ~ Bonnie is a friendly, happy go lucky girl looking for a place to call home. This adventurous girl enjoys going down to the river for a swim and getting out and about on walks. She has experience around children, where she enjoys walks, play and pats from her smaller human friends. Bonnie gets along well with other Greyhounds, so pending a meet and greet, may find her forever home with another medium to large canine companion. With access to a backyard for toileting, occasional zoomies or catching some afternoon rays, Bonnie has proven to excel at pet life and can't wait to bring lots of love and fun into her new home! Meet Bonnie at Western Sydney!

NAME: Archer
TEXT: Archer is an affectionate, friendly boy searching for a forever home filled with love, snuggles, and good company. 💛🐾 Archer loves people and joining his humans for walks, garden playtime, and fun car-ride adventures. He’s also gentle and loving with kids 6+ and will happily play chase in the yard before coming back for pats - his absolute favorite thing! He's easy going and doesn't need long walks; a quick zoomie and play in the yard is enough some days for workers. He's ok on his own, or good with gentle small dogs. He settles beautifully in a crate and is learning to be a calm inside dog with great house manners. Archer is a sweet soul who wants nothing more than to be with his people. He would thrive with a family or someone who’s home often and looking for a loyal companion. If you’re searching for a gentle, devoted best friend, Archer is your guy. 💕🐶

NAME: Pint
TEXT: Meet Pint — your new little pocket rocket of joy! 🚀🐶 This sweet young girl is full of energy, enthusiasm, and heart. She may greet you with a bit of nervous excitement at first, but it doesn’t take long for her true personality to shine through. Pint loves people, wants to please, and quickly settles in for cuddles once she knows she’s safe. Pats? Yes please! Pint is happiest when she’s by your side—whether it’s heading out for a walk, hopping in the car for an adventure, or snoozing near your desk while you work. She’s spent time in an office environment meeting new people and handled it like a champ. She also does well with small dogs and enjoys friendly company. If you’re looking for a cheerful, affectionate companion who’s ready to join you on life’s adventures, Pint is the perfect match. She would suit an active couple or family with older kids, who have time to spend with her and nurture her. She's pretty, sweet and does flop on the grass to rest when she's had her walk or playtime - you’ll fall in love in an instant! 💛🐾

NAME: Flossy
TEXT: Flossy is a beautiful greyhound who’s nearly 9 years young and still full of grace. She’s the perfect mix of calm and affectionate, making her an ideal companion for someone looking for a loving, easygoing friend. Personality: Flossy is gentle, sweet-natured, and loves being part of a family. She enjoys quiet moments and will happily curl up beside you for a snooze. Compatibility: She gets along well with other dogs, so she’d fit perfectly into a multi-pet household. Lifestyle: Flossy is past her racing days and prefers a relaxed pace. A comfy bed, a few short walks, and plenty of cuddles are all she needs to thrive.

NAME: Benny
TEXT: Meet Benny🐾🐶 Benny is a bright, joyful greyhound with a heart as big as his smile. Affectionate and people-oriented, he adores spending time with children and is wonderfully gentle with them. His calm, steady nature makes him a fantastic family companion. This charming boy is also a dream to take anywhere—Benny travels beautifully in vehicles and is a relaxed passenger on any outing. On walks, he’s a pleasure to handle, strolling politely on the lead and enjoying every chance to explore the world around him. Benny gets along brilliantly with other large dogs and loves having canine friends to share his adventures. He would suit be a singular pet or in a household with another M/L pup. His happy, exuberant personality shines through in everything he does, and he’s always ready to offer affection, snuggles, and a wagging tail. If you’re looking for a sweet, dependable, and joyful companion, Benny might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Vicky
TEXT: Vicky is a stunning girl who is confident and social. She has a bubbly playful personality and she is fun and sweet to be around. She can conquer stairs, she is very polite and clean inside and she is happy to be alone to look after things and catch up on some Z's while your out. She would suit many lifestyle as she is confident and affectionate.

NAME: Astro
TEXT: Astro is a heart-melting, affectionate boy looking for a forever home full of love, snuggles, and good company. While he's great with dogs of all sizes, he requires a home without another dog in the home but would thrive with doggy play dates and group walkies. He settles well in a crate and has shown to know his name and learning recall. This sweet soul is very cuddly and affectionate – a true Velcro dog who wants to be near his people. Whether it's curling up on the couch, following you around the house, or gently resting his head on your lap, Astro’s love knows no bounds. He’s a great inside dog with lovely house manners, making him a perfect match for someone who is home more often than not. If you’re looking for a loyal best friend who gives as much love as he gets, Astro is your guy. Astro is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Otto
TEXT: Hi, I'm Otto! I am a friend to all big and small, so if you have a home with another dog I'd love to meet them. I love food and would do well with ongoing training as I am super friendly and eager to please you. I am great indoors and would suit longer hours left alone due to my calm and easy going nature. I am nice on the lead and would enjoy going on trots around the block. I am a very sweet boy and can't wait to meet you! You can meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Milo (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *I've just gone into a foster home! Stay tuned for updates* Hi, I'm Milo. I love to get pats and will contort myself into weird positions to get all those good scratches! The team effortlessly fell in love with me when I first arrived here. I could suit longer hours left alone once I build up a good routine as I have been shown to be easy going and laid back during alone times. I am very friendly and think my happy nature would suit children. I am an engaging, charismatic boy who still knows how to have a good time. I love to play bow and have my silly moments, but I am overall relaxed and can't wait to snooze in a sunny spot at your place. I like settling inside a crate and would suit an apartment home with lift access. I'm a polite boy with other greyhounds and would happily join a family with another dog my size at home. I am gentle on the lead and I still love playing with toys! I hope you're interested in meeting me! I'm available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Swipper
TEXT: Snipper is a great young hound with no intention of being anything other than a loving companion. He is very friendly and affectionate, especially around little people.

NAME: Angus
TEXT: Angus is a handsome fawn greyhound with a heart full of joy and energy. At 5 years old, he’s the perfect mix of playful and laid-back. His absolute favorite pastime? Playing ball! Whether it’s chasing after it in the yard or proudly carrying it around, Angus lights up when there’s a ball involved. He’s affectionate, gentle, and loves spending time with his humans. Angus would thrive in a home where he can enjoy regular play! With his sweet nature and love for fun, he’s sure to bring endless smiles to his forever family. Ideal Home: A family who enjoys interactive play A secure yard for ball games Lots of love and attention

NAME: Paula
TEXT: Paula is a charming happy girl who is currently friends with American staffies and chihuahua's. Paula walks nicely on the lead and has a stunning personality! She is soft and gentle around other dogs and would be suitable to live in a multi-dog household. She's been good with kids and would love a backyard to explore during the day while you're gone. A doggy pal will help teach her about your routine! We can't wait to see Paula become your new best friend!

NAME: Lady
TEXT: Lady is a vibrant girl with a fun loving personality. She is confident, excitable and bouncy. We would recommend older kids/teens as her best fit. She would love an active, engaged family who can include her in daily activities and keep her busy during the day. She would benefit from a family who can continue dog training and foundational pet skills with her. Lady is available by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Pepper is a cute girl who loves to hug you! She will jump and ask for a cuddle. She loves travelling and going on adventures and having fun. She is excitable around dogs so a friendly tolerant dog her size would be suitable for Pepper. She is confident and loving and can't wait to find her forever family! She is a lot of fun and would love a backyard and even children to keep her entertained! Meet Pepper at the Western Sydney adoption centre by appointment.

NAME: Lizzie
TEXT: *I'm in foster care, updates to come!* Lizzie is a shy, gentle girl who is friendly with people once she's warmed up to you. She loves soft toys, knows her name, travels well and generally sleeps for the ride! This gentle girl is soft and polite around other dogs, making her a lovely companion for someone looking for a laid back companion for their dog. She is more confident around other dogs and would benefit from a calm, relaxed home with a nurturing and understanding nature. Meet Lizzie at Western Sydney.

NAME: Roxy
TEXT: Meet Roxy – Your Sweet, Easy-Going Adventure Buddy Roxy is a beautiful 7-year-old girl with a truly lovely nature. She’s gentle, easy going, and happiest when she’s with her people. From the moment you meet her, Roxy’s friendliness shines through—she walked straight up to her foster carer on day one and has been happily seeking pats and attention ever since. She responds warmly to her name and loves checking in with you, moving back and forth for affection. Nothing seems to bother this calm girl, not even her foster carer using crutches—Roxy simply adapts and carries on with her relaxed, happy demeanor. She enjoys new adventures, meeting new people, and soaking up all the pats she can get. With low distractions, she settles beautifully and is perfectly content just being near someone who gives her a little love. Roxy is also dog-social. She recently passed a small Cavoodle at the kennels and didn’t pay any attention—earning herself the unofficial title of “trainer’s pet” for her polite, steady behaviour. If you’re looking for a friendly, affectionate companion who brings joy everywhere she goes, Roxy might just be your perfect match. She’s ready for her next chapter with someone who’ll appreciate her sweet soul and gentle heart.

NAME: Warnie
TEXT: This handsome boy is great with kids and loves meeting new people. He lives well in the backyard and is very social with other dogs. He is currently living in a suburban area with family that work fulltime hours. He is good clean boy and loves keeping you company.

NAME: Enzo
TEXT: *I'm in foster care with another greyhound!* Foster Update: "Loves having a dog or human companion. Fully toilet trained and can use a doggy door. Loves playing fetch with a ball or squeaky toy. Playful and so full of joy, jumps up (but not on you, like a kangaroo) when he's excited that you're home. Loves a bum pat, and when you're sitting down he'll scooch himself over your knee like he's trying to be a lap dog. No drive towards birds or medium to large dogs." Enzo is the perfect blend of calm, playful, goofy and loving. He enjoys spending time in the office and although he tolerates the chaos of the office, he ideally would prefer a calm and quiet lifestyle. A home with a backyard in a quieter area would be best for this boy and pending a meet and greet, a home with another medium to large dog could work for him too! He has loved playing with all of his Greyhound friends and is super social with all the people he meets when he's out and about. When he is left alone, he has shown to settle quite well so could suit a home where his humans are home less often throughout the day. This adorable boy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Apollo
TEXT: Apollo is a calculated sweetheart, he is very composed and polite. He likes to play with toys and enjoys a walk. He loves a cuddle and is super affectionate. He is a very content well balanced boy.

NAME: Ruby
TEXT: Ruby is a curious, affectionate girl. She has her energetic side where she will zoom around and chase toys, then she has her lazy affectionate side. She is good with other dogs and is comfortable on her own.

NAME: Bishop
TEXT: Bishop is a well balanced boy. He is very funny and lovable, and wont leave many dull moments in his presence. He is also very sweet and affectionate> He loves a walk and he loves to lounge around afterwards.

NAME: Panda
TEXT: Panda is a very tidy dog who is easy to train and fit in. He is confident and very affectionate. He loves to play and loves to wipe out and relax by your side. He is comfortable on his own which would make him suitable for fulltime workers or a busy family

NAME: Busta
TEXT: Busta is a great boy who loves to keep you company and hang out. He is a good walker on the lead and likes everyone he meets. He is friendly and social with other dogs and is confident when doing new things.

NAME: Casper
TEXT: Casper gets along with everybody, he is great with kids, great with all different size and breeds of dogs he has met so far. Has been exposed to native animals. Good on his own. Has had excellent prep to be your next family member.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: This handsome blue fawn boy is great company, he is very healthy vibrant boy who enjoys a walk and is happy to look after the yard. He is good inside and happy to relax with you.

NAME: Blocker
TEXT: This handsome young gentleman has been living on the south coast around young girls that often play with him, small dogs and has visits from native animals. He is a well behaved boy inside and is great company. He confident and happy, he responds well to his name and enjoys meeting new people on local walks.

NAME: Ozzie
TEXT: This handsome young fella never raced and has always been destined for pet life. He would thrive in a family environment due to his sweet and gentle nature. He has great recall and is great looking after the yard. He relaxes well on his own and is a confident young hound.

NAME: Bulky
TEXT: Bulky is a stunning young boy. He is very gentle yet playful. He gets along with all dogs, is great with children and has been exposed to a range of animals including natives where he currently resides on the south coast. He would be perfect for a growing family due to his lovely nature and ability to relax on his own while life everyone has school and work.

NAME: Finn
TEXT: *Finn is in a foster home - updates to come!* Handsome blue brindle boy Finn is looking for his forever home! Finn is a confident and outgoing guy and has won over everyone here at GAP with his charming personality! Finn could suit a variety of homes including family homes with respectful kids, homes with another medium/large dog, apartment living and/or homes with full-time workers. As long as there are people to love, toys to play with and comfy beds to snooze on, Finn is happy! Finn walks well on the lead and since he absolutely loves his food, he has responded very well to early training including on-lead recall, stairs training and down on cue. We just know this handsome boy will be turning heads when you're walking or out and about on the town! If you are ready for this georgous boy to join your family, apply to adopt Finn today!

NAME: Andy
TEXT: Meet Andy🐾 Say hello to Andy, a sweet-natured boy with a heart as big as his beautiful brown eyes. Andy is the perfect blend of independence and affection — happy to do his own thing, but always ready for a cuddle or a gentle pat when you’re nearby. Andy is fantastic with dogs of all shapes and sizes and absolutely adores children, making him the ideal addition to a family home. He’s a calm and confident traveller who settles easily in the car, and he walks beautifully on the lead — no pulling, just relaxed strolls at your side. When he’s not enjoying a walk or some quiet company, Andy is perfectly content to entertain himself in the yard, watching the world go by or lounging in the sunshine. He’s an easy-going boy who takes life in stride and brings a lovely, peaceful energy wherever he goes. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate companion who’s as happy snuggling on the couch as he is exploring the outdoors, Andy is your guy.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Hi, I'm Charlie, a pretty little lady who can't wait to be your new best mate. I walk nicely on the lead and I'm learning to be confident in new places. A slow introduction to the big wide world will suit me best, but I know you'll help me be brave! I am very sweet and would suit a home with a dog my size and older kids who can show me all about play time and treats. Meet me by appointment from Western Sydney.

NAME: Shak
TEXT: Shak is what we affectionatly call a BFG (Big Friendly Giant). He is a big boy who is super affectionate, and he's a greyhound who sees everyone as his friend! He is confident, charming and has a lovely personable nature which we all love. This beautiful boy would be suited to family life, outings and spending time playing with older children due to his size. He'd love a backyard to zoom around and if you're home more often than not at the start of his adoption journey, we think he'd thrive and settle in well! Shak can be adopted via appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bugsy
TEXT: Meet Bugsy🌼 Say hello to Bugsy, a gorgeous, easy going greyhound with a heart full of love and a calm, affectionate nature. Bugsy is the kind of dog who takes everything in stride — relaxed, friendly, and happiest when surrounded by good company. She’s wonderful with dogs, cats, and children, and currently lives peacefully with a cheeky Jack Russell and her best friend, fellow greyhound Ivy. Bugsy and Ivy share a very special bond — they’ve grown up together and are truly inseparable. Where one goes, the other isn’t far behind! They bring out the best in each other and would love to find a forever home side by side. Bugsy has a beautifully gentle and calm temperament. She’s affectionate without being demanding, loves her cuddles and pats, and is always up for a quiet walk or a lazy afternoon nap. She’s the kind of dog who fits seamlessly into family life — content to simply be near her people and enjoy their company. With her sweet, steady personality, Bugsy is the perfect companion for anyone looking for a loyal, low-maintenance friend. Together with Ivy, she’ll bring warmth, peace, and double the love to her new home. 💛 If you’re searching for a pair of calm, loving greyhounds who get along beautifully with everyone — from other pets to kids — Bugsy and Ivy are ready to fill your heart (and your couch!) with joy. See Ivy's profile : https://www.gapnsw.com.au/our-greyhounds/ivy-7

NAME: Ivy
TEXT: Meet Ivy🐾 Say hello to Ivy, a beautiful, gentle girl with a calm and loving nature. She’s the kind of girl who quietly wins your heart with her sweetness and soft eyes. Ivy is wonderful with cats, dogs, and children, and she’s already lived happily alongside a lively Jack Russell and her best mate, a fellow greyhound named Bugsy. Ivy and Bugsy are a bonded pair, which means they share a very special friendship. They’ve grown up together and take comfort in each other’s company — whether they’re lounging side by side, exploring the garden, or curling up for an afternoon nap. Where you find one, you’ll find the other close by! Ivy can be a little shy when meeting new people, but once she’s settled and knows she’s safe, her gentle personality shines through. She has a wonderfully calm, easy going nature and loves the simple things in life — a quiet walk, a soft bed, and the company of her friends. She’s polite, affectionate, and happiest when surrounded by those she trusts. Bugsy is her steady companion and a bit more confident, which helps Ivy feel secure in new situations. Together, they make a perfectly balanced team — calm, friendly, and full of love to share. Ivy and Bugsy are looking for a loving home where they can stay together. They’ll bring peace, companionship, and plenty of quiet joy to their new family. If you’re searching for a pair of gentle souls who get along beautifully with everyone they meet — humans, hounds, or even cats — these two might just be the perfect match. 💚 See Bugsy's profile : https://www.gapnsw.com.au/our-greyhounds/bugsy

NAME: Ivy
TEXT: Meet Ivy🌿 Lovely Ivy is a sweet, soft-natured lady who’s ready to find her place in the world. She’s already had a taste of home life and knows all about the comforts of a cozy couch and a quiet corner to nap in. Ivy currently lives happily with other dogs and really enjoys their company — she’s a calm, easy going companion who loves to “cruise” alongside her canine friends. She takes her time to get to know new people and situations, but once she’s settled, her gentle personality truly shines. Because she’s a little shy at first, Ivy would really benefit from foster care — a patient, loving environment where she can build confidence at her own pace, even with a friendly dog or two to show her the ropes. If you’re looking for a quiet sweetheart who gets along beautifully with other pups and will reward your kindness with quiet devotion, Ivy might be your perfect match. 💚

NAME: Flo
TEXT: Meet Flo🐾 Say hello to Flo, a bright, bubbly greyhound with a heart full of joy and a love for life! Having already spent time in a home environment, Flo knows all about the comforts of pet life — soft beds, friendly faces, and a good routine. She’s now ready to bring her cheerful personality into a new forever home. Flo currently lives with other greyhounds and gets along beautifully with them. She’s also fantastic with other dogs of all shapes and sizes, always polite and friendly in her interactions. Her easy going nature makes her a wonderful companion for multi-dog households or a great new friend for anyone looking to add a sociable greyhound to their family. This lovely girl is naturally happy, outgoing, and full of charm. She enjoys being part of the action, whether it’s going for walks, playing in the garden, or simply following her humans around the house. Flo truly thrives on human company — she loves being near people, soaking up attention, and sharing in whatever’s happening around her. One of Flo’s best traits is how well she settles into new environments. She takes change in her stride and quickly makes herself at home, adapting to new routines and surroundings with confidence and ease. Whether it’s a busy household or a quieter home, Flo’s laid-back yet cheerful attitude helps her fit right in. If you’re looking for a friendly, affectionate, and adaptable greyhound who will bring happiness and warmth wherever she goes, Flo is your girl. With her sunny nature and loving heart, she’s sure to make every day brighter. 💛

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Hi, I’m Millie! I’m a young greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger personality. I still have a lot of puppy energy, which means I love exploring, giving kisses, and having fun—but don’t worry my foster carer says I’m not a chewer! I can be known to dig sometimes, but with training i'll grow out of this. I’m a zoomie queen and adore chasing my foster brother around the yard. Digging and playing with toys are my favorite hobbies (though sometimes my idea of a “toy” makes my foster mum laugh!). I’m learning to walk nicely on a lead and picking it up quickly. I already know commands like my name, stay, no, and out, and I’m a fast learner. Food is my love language and I am very clean inside! I’m a goofy girl who absolutely loves kids and I am very intuitive. If you’re looking for a playful, affectionate companion who will keep you smiling, I’m your girl.

NAME: Jake
TEXT: Hey, I'm Jake! I'm a lovely and friendly boy, who gets along great with other greyhounds, happy settled alone in a crate, not to mention I'm food motivated which everyone says here at the centre makes it easy for me to learn "pet skills"! I am polite with other dogs on walks including the little dogs I see around, making me suitable for urban life. I would also be suitable in an apartment with lift access. I think I'm the perfect match for a family with children with busy lifestyles as I'm an easy going boy who takes it all in my stride! Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Aussie
TEXT: Say hello to Aussie! 🐾 Aussie is a handsome 4-year-old black boy with a big heart and an even bigger love for people. If there’s a pat going, Aussie’s first in line — he never says no to some quality human affection! He’s a dream to have around: walks beautifully on the lead, travels well, and has a calm, social nature that makes him great company wherever he goes. The handsome gentleman is more than happy to entertain himself in the backyard or curl up with you on the couch. He is great walking on the lead and has no issues exploring new places. Aussie gets along wonderfully with dogs of all shapes and sizes — small, medium, and large — and is always up for making new friends. With his gentle manners, easygoing vibe, and love for life, Aussie would make an amazing addition to almost any home. 💙

NAME: Billy Bob
TEXT: Billy Bob is a lovable, easygoing companion who would make a wonderful addition to the right home. He gets along beautifully with medium to large dogs and navigates stairs with ease. He’s a true chill buddy! he could do really well in an apartment and enjoys relaxing at home. While he can handle being on his own for moderate periods, a calm, low-stimulus environment is best if he’ll be left for longer stretches. He would thrive in a family with plenty of people to cuddle, he adores the couch and loves snuggling with his humans If you’re looking for a friendly, adaptable, and loving companion, Billy Bob is ready to become a cherished part of your family!

NAME: Selwin
TEXT: Meet Selwin 🖤 Say hello to Selwin, a gorgeous boy with a soft heart, curious mind, and a lifetime of love to give. Selwin may take a little time to warm up, but once he trusts you, you’ll have a loyal and affectionate companion by your side. Selwin has grown up around children and knows how to be calm and gentle in their presence. He’s also well-socialised with other dogs, getting along beautifully with medium and large breeds—including other greyhounds and even a German Shepherd buddy! He’d love a home where he can share space with canine companions or be your one-and-only shadow. This sweet boy has a thoughtful, inquisitive nature. He enjoys taking in the world at his own pace and has proven to be unfazed by nearby farm animals like sheep and horses—nothing much rattles Selwin's cool composure.

NAME: Malley
TEXT: Hi, I'm Malley! I've been learning lots of things about the world while I wait to be adopted. I am super friendly and will make a sensational first impression, if I do say so myself! I am very charming and think you will just love me! I know what a lounge is, how to navigate those weird things called "stairs", and have enjoyed spending time in an open crate, and spending time indoors, too. I'm a good traveller, I also love toys and treats and my handlers call me a big softie! I would prefer short hours alone as a solo pet and a slow intro to the big wide world as my horizons slowly expand as a pet with you. If you thought you might like a big affectionate softie like me simply reach out to the Western Sydney adoption centre :)

NAME: Hilary
TEXT: Meet Hilary🐾 Say hello to Hilary, a lovely greyhound with a calm, curious spirit and a heart full of adventure. Having lived in a home before, Hilary already knows the comforts of family life — she settles in quickly and enjoys being part of the household routine. Hilary is fantastic with dogs of all shapes and sizes. She’s social, gentle, and gets along well with everyone she meets — canine or human! Whether she’s sharing her space or joining her doggy pals on a walk, she’s a pleasure to have around. One of Hilary’s favourite things is hopping into the car — she travels beautifully and would be the perfect companion for a road trip or a day out exploring new places. She’s not easily phased by much; loud noises, new environments, and busy surroundings don’t seem to bother her one bit. Hilary is still learning to be her best self on the lead and will benefit from a bit more lead training, but she’s eager to please and a quick learner. With a little patience and consistency, she’ll be strolling confidently beside you in no time. Calm, affectionate, and full of quiet charm, Hilary would make a wonderful addition to almost any family. She’s the kind of dog who takes life as it comes, ready for a cuddle on the couch or an adventure in the car — as long as she’s with her people, she’s happy.

NAME: Brook
TEXT: Meet Brook🐾 Say hello to Brook, a beautiful, gentle lady with a heart full of love and a personality that shines wherever she goes. Brook is the kind of dog who seems to make friends everywhere — she absolutely adores other dogs and gets along wonderfully with canine companions of all shapes and sizes. Whether she’s joining in for a gentle play session or just relaxing beside them, Brook’s calm and friendly nature makes her a joy to be around. Brook has lived inside a home before, so she already understands what it means to be part of a family. She quickly settles into new environments and makes herself comfortable, as though she’s always been there. Her easy going and adaptable temperament means she takes new experiences in stride. When it comes to people, Brook is very affectionate. She loves spending time with her humans, whether that’s enjoying a gentle walk, curling up for cuddles, or simply being nearby while you go about your day. She has a soft, loving nature that makes her a wonderful fit for families with children of any age — she’s patient, kind, and always up for a little bit of love and attention. Brook is the perfect mix of playful curiosity and gentle calm. She’ll happily explore her yard or new surroundings, then find a comfy spot to rest and soak up the sunshine. Her ability to adapt, along with her affectionate spirit, means she’ll fit beautifully into almost any household. If you’re looking for a loyal, loving, and easy going companion who will bring warmth and happiness to your home, Brook is the girl for you. She’s ready to meet her forever family and share all the love she has to give!

NAME: Benny
TEXT: Meet Benny🐾 Say hello to Benny, our big-hearted greyhound with an even bigger personality! This handsome lad is full of life, energy, and affection — the perfect mix of fun and love. Benny absolutely adores people and thrives on human company. Whether he’s greeting you with a wagging tail or leaning in for pats, he’s sure to win you over in seconds. Benny would love a family with a backyard where he can stretch his long legs, zoom around, and play to his heart’s content. After playtime, he’s more than happy to flop down and relax, enjoying some quiet time — he’s quite independent when he wants to be! When it comes to other dogs, Benny can be a bit selective with male dogs, so he’d likely be happiest as the only dog in his new home (as long as he has that backyard and plenty of human love, he’ll be in heaven!). If you’re looking for a big, goofy, affectionate companion who’ll make you smile every day, Benny is your boy. He’s ready to fill your home with love, laughter, and a few joyful zoomies!

NAME: Helen
TEXT: Meet Helen – A Gentle Heart Looking for a Quiet Home 💗🐾 Helen is a soft-natured and gentle girl with a truly loving soul. She adores affection and leans into you for cuddles and pats, staying close to soak up every bit of love. Calm and sensitive, Helen would thrive in a quiet household and has household experience. She’s the kind of companion who will quietly be by your side, offering comfort and warmth with her gentle presence. Helen will make a great companion inside and outside the house. She walks beautifully on the lead, not reactive to other dogs, and loves adventures in the car to the shops! If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate girl who just wants a peaceful place to call home, Helen is the one for you.

NAME: Polly
TEXT: Meet Polly! 🌸 Polly is a lovely-natured, friendly, and easy-going girl who adores human company and loves being by your side. She’s happiest when she can be part of whatever’s going on and would make a wonderful, loyal companion. She enjoys her walks, playing with her Jack Russell pals, or just pottering about with you in the yard or garden. Polly is comfortable around kids 11+ and has a calm, happy nature that makes her a joy to have around. A simple, relaxed lifestyle would suit Polly perfectly — she’d be an ideal match for a retiree or anyone looking for a gentle yet fun friend who’s happy to share both companionship and quiet time. 💛

NAME: Kay
TEXT: Kay is sweet, shy and sensitive. She is gentle on the lead and is currently quite reserved in new situations. We think this gorgeous girl will thrive in a calm, steady home, who are able to take things at her pace. An adults only (or potentially dog experienced older kids/teenagers) home would suit Kay best while she learns how to be a pet with you. She would do best in a home with a fenced yard so she can retreat when needed. She is polite around other dogs however would do best with a slow introduction to socialisation while she finds her feet as a pet. Someone who is home more often than not to help nurture Kay into a beloved family member will be the best fit for Kay. Meet our lovely Kay at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Arrow
TEXT: We’ve all heard the old saying, time flies like an arrow. Well this young boy Arrow certainly flies around the yard as fast as he can. Arrow is an energetic, elegant boy who is a shy boy right now but we know he will become a confident pet! Arrow absolutely loves his food and will do well with training in his home. Arrow can be jumpy and excitable at times so a home with experienced owners and older children would be beneficial for him. Once his excitement has settled he can be found smooching by your side for some love and affection. He would be best suited to a home that works part time hours; as he enjoys having the company and endless supply of treats around. A home with a backyard would be ideal and he wouldn’t mind if his new home had a medium to large friendly companion. Apply online to secure a meet and greet with this special young man at our Western Sydney Facility.

NAME: Angie
TEXT: Angie is a gentle and reserved girl looking for a calm, adults only home. She comes when called and has a gorgeous, soft personality. She is placid and would enjoy a quiet home which would help her gain confidence. A fully fenced house/townhouse yard for somewhere for Angie to retreat and get away from the hustle and bustle is the best fit for her. Her gentle nature sees her adapt well to socialisation with big and small dogs. Angie is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: If you're looking for a playful, engaged dog who is polite with other dogs and who would enjoy an active, fun life, consider adopting Rocky. Rocky is a friendly brindle boy who has experience with kids 12+. He loves a scratch behind the ear and has a confident, outgoing nature. He is a social butterfly and would enjoy being a part of family activities whether that's walks to school or going to the park. He can be excited to get going on walks so an owner who can handle a strong dog is recommended. Rocky is available by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Maxine
TEXT: Pretty little brindle girl Maxine is a shy girl looking for a supportive home to guide her into pet life. Maxine is described as quiet and with a beautiful gentle nature. Maxine could live with other medium-large dogs and older/respectful kids. As she can be shy, a family who can help her thrive into a confident pet would be the best fit, eg a home experienced with shy dogs, or a homebody family. Shorter hours alone would be her best fit while she learns your routine. Maxine is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Stella
TEXT: Meet Stella🌟 Say hello to Stella, a gorgeous greyhound with a heart as big as her smile! This social butterfly absolutely adores her canine friends and loves nothing more than a good play session with her doggy pals. Stella isn’t fazed by much — she takes everything in her stride with her calm, easy-going nature. Whether she’s out on an adventure or lounging at home, Stella is simply happy to be part of the fun. She’s a big fan of her humans too! Pats, ear rubs, and cuddles are always on her wish list, and she’ll happily follow you around or curl up at your feet once playtime is over. When she’s not making friends, Stella enjoys playing with her toys or just relaxing in a comfy spot nearby. With her affectionate personality and playful charm, she’s the perfect all-round companion. Stella’s dream home is one where she can share her days with loving humans (and maybe a furry friend or two) who will give her the love and attention she so happily returns.

NAME: Jebbers
TEXT: This boy may seem uninterested at first, however he is just careful and makes wise choices. Since being a pup he has always been careful and calculated. This boy is inquisitive and confident, he just has a quirky personality. He is good on his own and is social with other dogs.

NAME: Vern
TEXT: Vern is a gentleman who walks nicely on the lead, who is confident and happy around new people and happy to go gentle walks around the block everyday. A fenced backyard and a home who will include him in daily activities would be a great fit for him. Vern has a positive and welcoming nature which would see him suit a family with children. Meet Vern by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Hi, I'm Billy! I'm a handsome fawn boy looking to find my perfect forever home. He is happy exploring new places and would enjoy a home with a fenced yard to call his own. He would love to be included in daily adventures like walks to and from the school pick up or spending time at the park! Billy is suitable to live with other dogs after a meet and greet. You can meet Billy at the Western Sydney adoption centre by appointment.

NAME: Hank
TEXT: This handsome boy is a high energy, loving guy looking to bounce into your home. He loves a pat and a bit of attention but is also happy to do his own thing. He has a charming and personable nature who we think would get along well with children and other dogs. Meet Hank by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: Affectionate boy Teddy is a sweet boy who walks gently on the lead and will greet you with a gentle tail wag. He is a calm, loving and sooky boy looking for someone to dote on him. He's easy to walk and has an easy going nature. He is friendly around other greyhounds and would suit a home with another dog. This cutie is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Stoker
TEXT: Looking for a Greyhound full of charm, confidence, and a love for affection? Meet our girl Stoker! Stoker is a friendly girl who loves all the humans she's met while she's out and about! She absolutely adores pats and is super affectionate. She has been around kids aged 2+. Whether it's a quiet evening snoozing or a stroll around the block, she’s happy just being by your side. Stoker wouldn't mind sharing her new home with another medium to large dog, and she might even be happy with a smaller canine companion, pending a meet and greet. Stoker could be the perfect addition to your family! Meet her at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bobby
TEXT: Friendly boy Bobby has been spending time learning about the world awaiting his forever home. This includes spending time with kids aged 1+, spending time around other breeds of dogs making him an adaptable well rounded hound, perfect for many home types! Bobby would enjoy a townhouse or backyard and his confident nature means he'd be happy living in suburbia, with children or going on daily walkies! Bobby is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Freddy
TEXT: Meet Freddie🚗 Say hello to Freddie, a happy, friendly greyhound who’s always ready for his next adventure! This handsome boy is the perfect mix of laid-back and enthusiastic — he loves meeting new people, exploring new places, and, most of all, hopping in the car for a good old-fashioned road trip. Freddie is an absolute star traveller. Whether it’s a quick ride around town or a longer journey, he settles in beautifully and enjoys watching the world go by from the back seat. He’s the ultimate co-pilot, always up for an outing and never one to say no to an adventure. When it comes to socialising, Freddie’s as easy-going as they come. He’s very friendly and happy when meeting new people — tail wagging, big smiles, and all the charm you could ask for. He also gets along wonderfully with medium and large dogs, enjoying their company and a good bit of canine social time. And if there’s one thing Freddie truly loves (besides travel and friends), it’s food! He’s wonderfully food-motivated, which makes training and bonding a breeze — and ensures he’s always ready for a tasty treat or two. Freddie would suit a home that enjoys getting out and about, but he’s just as content relaxing after a day’s adventure. With his friendly personality, love for life, and easy-going nature, Freddie is sure to make every day feel like a road trip worth taking.

NAME: Betty
TEXT: Meet Betty🌸 Say hello to Betty, a beautiful older girl who proves that age is just a number. This lovely lady may have a few extra grey hairs, but she’s still young at heart and full of quiet charm. Betty is the perfect mix of calm, gentle, and affectionate — a true companion dog who simply loves being near her people. Betty gets along wonderfully with cats, dogs, and children, making her an easy fit in many homes. She’s kind and patient, always taking things at her own pace, and has a gentle, steady presence that puts everyone around her at ease. While she may be a little reserved at first, Betty really shines once she’s settled into her surroundings. With a bit of time and love, her sweet personality blossoms, you’ll soon see her tail wagging, her eyes bright, and her heart open to every bit of affection that comes her way. She walks beautifully on the lead, enjoying calm strolls where she can take in the sights and smells of the world without any rush. Because of her gentle nature, Betty would be best suited to a low-key, quiet household, perhaps with an elderly couple or someone looking for a relaxed, loving companion to share peaceful days with. If you’re looking for a kind, affectionate soul who will bring warmth, comfort, and quiet joy into your life, Betty is ready to be your loyal friend and faithful shadow.

NAME: Buffy
TEXT: Meet Buffy💖 Introducing Buffy, a beautiful, affectionate girl with a heart full of love and a personality that shines wherever she goes. Buffy is one of those dogs who seems to make friends wherever she sets paw — she’s super friendly, loves her humans, and is always ready for a cuddle or a gentle nuzzle to remind you she’s there. Buffy is a dream to walk. She’s calm, confident, and walks beautifully on the lead, taking her time to explore the world at an easy pace. She’s relaxed when meeting new people and handles new environments with grace, curiosity, and her signature wagging tail. Whether it’s a stroll through the park or a quiet wander around the neighbourhood, Buffy is the perfect walking companion. Social by nature, Buffy loves hanging out with her fellow greyhounds and gets along well with dogs of all shapes and sizes. She’s happy to make new canine friends and enjoys a bit of gentle play or simply relaxing side by side. Buffy can redirect her focus from cats when guided, but she’d benefit from slow, steady introductions to feline housemates to ensure everyone feels comfortable. At home, Buffy’s affectionate side really shines. She adores spending time with her people, whether that’s sharing the sofa for a cosy evening in or following you around just to be part of whatever you’re doing. She’s the perfect mix of gentle, loving, and easy-going — always ready to explore but equally happy to relax by your side. Buffy would make a wonderful companion for many different types of households. If you’re looking for a friendly, social, and affectionate greyhound who’ll fill your days with warmth, loyalty, and love, Buffy could be your perfect match.

NAME: Dillan
TEXT: Meet Dillan🐾 If you’re looking for a calm, gentle companion who knows how to take life easy, look no further than Dillan. This handsome greyhound is the very definition of relaxed. Whether he’s lounging in a sunny spot or taking a leisurely stroll, Dillan does everything with an effortless cool. Dillan loves spending time with his fellow greyhounds and is always up for a friendly sniff and a bit of social time. He can be a little cautious around smaller dogs, so he’d appreciate slow, calm introductions to get comfortable. Out on walks, Dillan is a dream – he walks beautifully on the lead and takes everything in his stride. He’s food-motivated, which makes training and bonding easy, and he’s a great traveller too, settling down nicely for the ride. Dillan would suit most households looking for an easy-going companion, ideally one where he can be the only pet so he can soak up all the love and attention. If you’re ready for a life of calm cuddles, peaceful walks, and a friend who radiates zen, Dillan is your guy.

NAME: Dottie
TEXT: Dottie is a happy, friendly, fun chilled out girl who loves hanging out around the house, she'd be a lounge lizard if she gets the chance! She is gentle with kids 5+ , small dogs (the household Jug) and other retired greyhounds who she enjoys a play with in the backyard. Energetic for short periods, loves her toys but her face lights up most when the lead comes out and she knows it's walkie time. She is easy on the lead and loves a walk with the 14 year old daughter. Dottie is a just a beautiful girl with a lovely confident nature, fitting in with life, sometimes energetic but also well behaved and easy going. She spends some time inside where she'd be happy to stay all day if she could with a daily walk. Dottie would be a great family dog or suit anyone who has time to spend with her, someone home or a part-time worker would be perfect but is happy to be on her own for a while snoozing or amusing herself with her toys. She would make someone a lovely companion or family pet. 💖 *Come meet Dottie at the Binalong Community Market Day on Sunday 9th November, 10am- 1pm.

NAME: Skye
TEXT: Meet Skye - Miss Personality! Skye is a happy, funny, and pretty blue girl with a big personality. She enjoys being by your side and nuzzling you for pats, is playful and loves everyone! Skye is great with kids 5+ and loves wandering around with you, her small dog friends, also hanging out with other greys. Skye has been living in the house and is not concerned with household noises, loves the couch, and is crate-trained. She loves water and will jump in her shell pool when she gets the chance, also a run around with her doggy friends, playing with toys and a going for a walk. She is a dream to walk on the lead. Skye is a beautiful, sweet and well-behaved girl, who can also live an only dog as she loves people, cuddles and just snuggling up to watch TV with you, too. What a gorgeous fun girl for a family or someone with time to give her the love and attention to bond together and watch her blossom. 💗

NAME: Bailey
TEXT: Meet Bailey – your happy blue best mate! Bailey is a beautiful, friendly blue boy who adores kids (6+) and loves nothing more than a game of chase and plenty of pats. He’s a joyful, affectionate lad who’s sure to bring laughter, love, and warmth into his new home. Bailey gets along well with his Greyhound pals as well as smaller dog friends (like a Mini Groodle, Mini Foxy, Pug, and Kelpie x), so he’d happily share his home with another friendly dog, even an indoor cat. He’s a pretty chill chap, who likes being inside, is house-trained and would suit a townhouse or house. Bailey is not over-energetic but loves his walks. If you’re looking for a loving, playful and easy care chap who’s great with kids and ready to be part of a family or any household, Bailey’s your boy!

NAME: Julie
TEXT: Miss Julie is a playful, friendly girl who loves her toys, a run around with the other dogs (retired greyhounds and Jug), a splash in her clam shell pool and just being around people and quiet kids 10+, not too rambunctious. She's a bit of a character, loves to show off but she's not over the top, just a happy girl! At 6 she hasn't lost energy but slows down faster and rests longer, especially as she is learning the comforts of retired life! Julie has spent the last 6 months living as a pet in the house and backyard and loves to be part of the action, loves a walk and playtime in the morning then a nice rest on the couch or your bed, where she likes to reside when you go out. She would be a loving companion for a quieter household, even a townhouse or apartment. Julie also loves toys, a shell pool, sandpit and a nice bone or chew. Someone home more often than not would be perfect. She's easy going and not worried by pet birds or small dogs. Just a sweetheart ready to relish retired life. 💗

NAME: Adal
TEXT: Adal – A Big Hunk of Love! Adal is the sweetest, affectionate boy with a big heart and just as much love to give. He’s great with all people, always happy to see you, excitable at times and loves showering you with kisses. This easy-going lad enjoys his walks, car rides, playtime with his toys, and hanging out with his greyhound friends, as well as playing with the resident Whippet and Jack Russell. Adal isn’t a fan of storms, but he handles them well by quietly retreating to his safe spot inside on his bed or in a kennel in the garage until the weather passes. He’s not vocal, destructive, or escape-prone—he just likes to hunker down until it’s over. With his lovely nature, happy personality, and endless love to share, Adal will make a wonderful companion, especially if someone is home or close by if a storm is coming, and can be on his own or with another dog to play with. 💙 *Come meet Adal at the Binalong Community Market Day on Sunday 9th November, 10am- 1pm.

NAME: Wren
TEXT: Wren is a gentle, sweet-natured girl who can be a bit shy at first, but once she's met you and let her come to you, her affectionate personality shines through. A few treats and a little chat go a long way with this lovely lady! She loves her morning zoomies and playtime with her retired greyhound friends, then settles in for some chill time with the family – including a small mixed-breed, a whippet, a Jack Russell, and three older greyhounds. She's well-behaved indoors and enjoys being part of the daily routine, including playing with a 2 year old girl. Wren walks beautifully on the lead and is calm and confident around town. She’s a happy, social girl who loves a gentle pat and attention. On the farm she does not worry about cows and horses nearby. Wren would make a wonderful companion in a variety of homes. She’d be happy as an only dog with someone who’s home often or works part-time from home. She’d also be delighted to share her home with a small, friendly dog, especially a whippet, and loves to lie on the lounge. If you're looking for a loyal, gentle, and loving new friend, Wren could be the perfect match for you! 💝

NAME: Dasha
TEXT: Meet Dasha – the darling girl with a playful streak! Dasha is a loving, calm, and confident girl who brings just the right mix of fun and relaxation. She enjoys her morning zoomies, a walk during the day, and another burst of play in the evening – the rest of the time, she’s more than happy to lounge on the couch. She's a cuddly teddy bear! She’s great with little dogs and having a zoomie buddy or being on her own, but most of all would be in her element living with a family with all the noise and bustle of kids and family life. She loves showing off, having the ball thrown to her, zooming around and playing with her toys, as much as she loves attention and snooze time. She's a great traveller and also loves her walks, being well behaved on the lead. Dasha is housetrained (she’ll let you know when she needs to go out!) . This chatty girl does have one funny quirk – a love for toilet paper – so keep your bathroom doors closed! With her loving nature and fun personality, Dasha will make a wonderful pet or companion.💘

NAME: Bull
TEXT: Bull is a nice boy who loves, playing, loves affection, is good on the lead. He likes meeting new people and new critters on his walks and is very social and outgoing with great character. He has been getting experience coming inside. There something about Bull that you will love.

NAME: Mikey
TEXT: Mikey is a handsome hound who is comfortable to be on his own looking after things while your at work. He is very social and has been exposed to a lot of the world that some dogs may not be use to like trains, cattle, native animals and he travels well on the road. He is happy to make new friends and get out and about and like most greyhounds is happy to relax. He has had some house experience and is wonderful company.

NAME: Tiny
TEXT: Tiny is a quiet little girl who is very sweet & often shy with new people. She becomes sweet and affectionate once you get to know her. A house or townhouse in the quiet neck of the woods, with a nurturing owner, would be the best fit for Tiny. She could also live in an apartment if it's spacious/quiet with safe zones to call her own - eg baby gates and secluded spaces. A quiet home where she can settle in and thrive would be perfect for Tiny, this means a home without children and pets/dogs. She can do stairs & enjoys sleeping in a crate, however not required. She has shown she can settle for longer periods here and would suit working up to full timers. It would be amazing to see someone nurture her confidence and guide her through the world. She becomes playful, loves chasing toys around, likes treats and food, and walks nicely on the lead. She's happy to take treats and likes learning and training. Tiny is a sweet little dog who will make an amazing pet once she has settled in. If you think Tiny sounds like the right girl for you then apply to meet her today.

NAME: Beast
TEXT: Meet Beast🐾 Despite his name, Beast is just a big goofball with an even bigger heart! This happy boy has perfected the art of smiling — seriously, one look at that grin and you’ll be smitten. Add in his constantly wagging tail, and you’ve got a living, breathing happiness machine! Beast is a true socialite who adores the company of his fellow greyhounds. Whether it’s a gentle play session or a backyard zoomie, he loves being part of the gang. Toys? Don’t even get him started! Beast is a toy enthusiast — squeaky, bouncy, or chewy, he’s not picky. Watching him toss his toys around is guaranteed entertainment. He also enjoys exploring a backyard, sniffing out all the best spots, and showing off his model-like strut (with a grin, of course). Beast is crate-savvy and perfectly happy to come and go as he pleases — he treats it like his personal den where he can relax after a busy day of smiling and tail-wagging. He’s engaging, affectionate, and loves to greet everyone he meets…no one escapes a “hello” from Beast! If you’re searching for a companion who brings sunshine, smiles, and maybe a few stolen socks into your life, Beast is your guy. With his charming personality and endless enthusiasm, this not-so-beastly boy is ready to fill your home (and your heart) with joy. 💚

NAME: Sophia
TEXT: Meet Sophia – the Sweet & Sophisticated Greyhound! 🐾 Sophia is a gentle 6-year-old greyhound with a calm, easy-going nature. She’s been around kids (ages 5 & 6) who can walk and feed her, and she takes it all in stride! While she might be a little reserved at first, once she feels at home her playful, affectionate side shines through. Sophia gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes and is the perfect mix of grace and goofiness.

NAME: Ernie
TEXT: Ernie is a shy boy who has made a lot of progress at the adoption centre. He is looking for a special home who will nurture him and continue his confidence building. He requires a family willing to take things slow with him as we have here. He would thrive as a solo dog with a 1-2 adults at home, or a calm dog to keep him company. He could spend a few hours alone or longer, with a secure yard or courtyard. He is very sweet, cuddle and adorable once he trusts you (see photos of all his cuddly moments!). It will be a highly rewarding journey for whoever adopts our special boy Ernie. He loves lying on blankets in the garden, sitting in his shell pool and cuddling you once he knows you. Meet Ernie by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack🐾 Say hello to Jack, a cheerful and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to find his forever family! Jack has grown up around children and is wonderfully gentle and patient with them — he loves being part of family life and joins in with whatever’s going on, always making sure everyone is happy and safe. This lovely boy gets along brilliantly with other large dogs and enjoys having a playmate who can keep up with his energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs at times, so he’d benefit from some calm, positive socialisation to help him feel more confident with them. Jack’s playful side really shines when he’s surrounded by his toys. He loves tossing them around, chasing after them, and showing off his collection to anyone who’ll watch! Between play sessions, Jack takes his role as “family supervisor” very seriously, checking in regularly with his people to make sure all is well before settling down again with a big grin and wagging tail. With his happy, affectionate nature and gentle heart, Jack would make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a fun, loving dog to share their days with. He’s full of character, always up for a bit of play, and even happier just to be near his humans. If you’re searching for a loyal, joyful friend who’ll bring laughter and love into your home, Jack is your guy. He’s ready to meet his forever family — and he can’t wait to check in with you! 💛🐶

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Meet Keith🐾 💛 Say hello to Keith, a stunning boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This charming boy has grown up surrounded by children, so he’s used to family life and all the noise, laughter, and cuddles that come with it. He’s gentle and patient with kids, always happy to join in on playtime or relax nearby while they do their thing. Keith is an excellent traveller, he hops into the car with ease and settles down quietly for the ride. Whether it’s a trip to the countryside or a quick run to the shops, he’s the perfect co-pilot who loves to be part of the action. When it comes to other dogs, Keith gets along beautifully with larger breeds and enjoys having a playmate of similar size and energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs and would benefit from some gentle, supervised socialisation. True to his greyhound nature, Keith is a lovely mix of playful and laid-back. He adores his bursts of energy in the garden or at the park — chasing toys, stretching those long legs, and showing off his zoomies, but he’s just as happy curling up for a snooze on the sofa afterwards. He’s got the balance just right! Keith would suit most family environments, especially those looking for a single dog who can be the centre of attention. He thrives on affection and companionship and will reward his new family with endless loyalty, love, and plenty of cuddles.

NAME: Coco
TEXT: *I've just gone into a foster home! Stay tuned for updates* Coco would love to live in a chilled out house or apartment (with a lift - no stairs). She is a very cute little senior lady with an adorable greying face. She is super affectionate, totally fine to be left alone (with no accidents or distress) perfect for those working longer hours. She gets along with greyhounds and medium to large dogs. She loves a treat and will be a breeze to train! This sweet little senior lady can't wait to snooze on your couch and be treated like the princess she is. Meet Coco at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bj
TEXT: Meet BJ🐾 BJ is a wonderful male greyhound who’s great with all dogs and would fit perfectly into a home with children. He’s had positive experiences around kids before, making him a calm and gentle companion for family life. This affectionate boy absolutely loves pats and cuddles — he’s always ready to lean in for some extra love and attention. BJ also enjoys a splash in shallow water, happily cooling off and having fun when the chance arises. With his friendly nature, love for affection, and easy going temperament, BJ is a fantastic all-rounder who will bring warmth and happiness to any household. If you’re looking for a sweet, sociable greyhound who thrives in a family environment and gets along with everyone, BJ could be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Honey
TEXT: Meet Honey🍯 Her name says it all – Honey is pure sweetness, with a playful streak that’s impossible not to love! Honey is a beautiful greyhound with a personality as sweet as her name! She’s a friendly, easy going girl who gets along wonderfully with dogs of all shapes and sizes, making her a lovely companion for both people and pups alike. A quiet and gentle soul at heart, Honey takes everything in her stride. She’s well used to travelling in cars and trailers, settling in comfortably wherever she goes — the perfect passenger for any adventure. Out and about, Honey can be a little strong on the lead at first, especially when she’s excited to explore, but she soon settles into a nice, steady rhythm. Once she’s in her stride, she’s a joy to walk beside. Honey also has a fun, playful side — she loves splashing about in the water and enjoys playing with her toys when she’s feeling lively. Whether it’s a gentle paddle, a game of chase, or some quiet time relaxing after a walk, Honey takes it all in her happy, calm way. With her sweet nature, gentle confidence, and love for both play and peace, Honey would make a wonderful addition to just about any home.

NAME: Rita
TEXT: Meet Rita💛 Rita is a lovely greyhound with a wonderfully relaxed outlook on life. She’s the kind of girl who takes everything in her stride — calm, content, and always happy to go with the flow. With her gentle nature and easy going temperament, Rita is a true pleasure to have around. She gets along beautifully with her fellow greyhounds and enjoys spending time with other medium and large dogs too. Whether she’s sharing a quiet snooze or having a gentle wander with her canine friends, Rita is friendly and well-mannered in every situation. Rita has that special “cruising through life” attitude — nothing seems to bother her, and she’s just as happy relaxing in the sunshine as she is joining in for a stroll or some family time. With her calm presence and kind heart, Rita would make a wonderful addition to almost any home. She’s the perfect companion for someone looking for a peaceful, loving dog who will fit effortlessly into daily life.

NAME: Bali
TEXT: Meet Bali🌴 Bali is a gorgeous girl with a gentle, calm nature and the happiest of hearts. She’s one of those dogs who simply radiates joy — her tail is nearly always wagging, and she greets each day with a smile and a nuzzle. This affectionate girl absolutely loves cuddles and will happily lean in for as many pats and smooches as she can get. Bali is a real people-dog who adores being close to her humans, soaking up all the love and attention on offer. While she’s calm and easy going most of the time, Bali also has a playful side that shines when she’s feeling relaxed. She enjoys a good run around and a bit of playtime, then is more than happy to settle down for some quiet snuggles afterwards. Bali is great with other medium and large dogs and enjoys their company, though she hasn’t yet been tested with smaller dogs. She would thrive in a home where she can share her gentle, affectionate nature and continue to enjoy both companionship and play. With her loving personality, calm presence, and ever-wagging tail, Bali is an all-round happy girl who’s ready to bring warmth, fun, and plenty of cuddles to her forever home.

NAME: Aria
TEXT: Meet Aria Aria is a beautiful lady with a bright, sweet personality and a lovely zest for life. True to her name, she brings a joyful tune to every day — confident, curious, and always ready to explore the world around her. This happy girl has a wonderful, sweet-natured temperament and enjoys spending time with both people and other dogs. She’s good with medium to large dogs and loves a bit of playtime with her canine pals. Aria hasn’t been tested with smaller dogs yet, so careful introductions would be needed if her new home includes them.
